# lol.trq.helios

> A rendering library for Minecraft Forge 1.8.9 on LWJGL 3: SDF shapes, MSDF text, shaders, framebuffers, blur and
> bloom. OpenGL 2.1 + GLSL 1.20 baseline, Java 17 bytecode, no Mixin, MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): requirements, packages, usage, harness
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): commit and test conventions

## Core source

- [Helios](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/Helios.java): entry point, one per GL context
- [GlBackend](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/gl/GlBackend.java): the GL seam
- [Gl21Backend](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/gl/Gl21Backend.java): OpenGL 2.1 baseline on LWJGL 3
- [StateGuard](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StateGuard.java): save on first touch, restore on close
- [GlStateCache](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/GlStateCache.java): host state cache seam
- [ShaderPreprocessor](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderPreprocessor.java): includes, defines, #line
- [ShaderLoader](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLoader.java): compile, link, reload
- [ShaderProgram](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderProgram.java): uniform location cache
- [ShaderLog](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLog.java): driver logs to file:line
- [FramebufferPool](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/fbo/FramebufferPool.java): framebuffer reuse, resize handling
- [Sdf](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/sdf/Sdf.java) and [sdf.glsl](helios/src/main/resources/lol/trq/helios/shaders/lib/sdf.glsl): distance and coverage
- [ShapeBatch](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/ShapeBatch.java) and [shape.fsh](helios/src/main/resources/lol/trq/helios/shaders/shape.fsh): batched primitives
- [Paint](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/Paint.java): solid, corner, linear and radial colour
- [Passes](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/Passes.java): capture, dual Kawase blur, composite, custom passes
- [Effects](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/Effects.java): blur behind a shape, bloom
- [PostChain](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/PostChain.java): chained full-screen passes
- [ScissorStack](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/state/ScissorStack.java): nested clipping
- [MinecraftHelios](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftHelios.java) and [MinecraftGlStateCache](helios/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/minecraft/MinecraftGlStateCache.java): the Minecraft hook

## Examples

- [StateGuardTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/state/StateGuardTest.java): guard semantics
- [ShaderPreprocessorTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderPreprocessorTest.java): include and define rules
- [ShaderLoaderTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/shader/ShaderLoaderTest.java): errors, uniform cache, reload
- [FramebufferPoolTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/fbo/FramebufferPoolTest.java): pooling and resize
- [SdfTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/sdf/SdfTest.java): distance and coverage math
- [ShapeBatchTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/batch/ShapeBatchTest.java): vertex layout, batching, flushes
- [EffectsTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/effect/EffectsTest.java): blur levels, bloom, post chain
- [ScissorStackTest](helios/src/test/java/lol/trq/helios/state/ScissorStackTest.java): clip conversion and nesting
- [HarnessMod](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/HarnessMod.java) and [Checks](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/Checks.java): in-game use and checks; [Model](harness-mod/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/mod/Model.java): software model of the shape shader

## Optional

- [Harness launcher](harness/src/main/java/lol/trq/helios/harness/DevLaunch.java): downloads and boots the game
